vignette: A 35-year-old man is found to have a small infarct of the right supramarginal gyrus after a cardiac embolus. Which of the following is the most likely persistent deficit?
explanation: The right inferior parietal lobule is the ventral attention hub; its lesion produces left neglect and extinction, often lasting because the superior longitudinal fasciculus II beneath it is interrupted. Aphasia and bilateral apraxia are left-hemisphere signs.
